items.description: Disposal of storm debris from shed and tree (roof timber, glass, green waste, root ball <1 m3)
items.rationale: All elements are material arising under 5.2.1(a)-(b), and the root ball is under one cubic metre, so the combined position is wholly indemnifiable under 7.1.10. The amount is calibrated on Case 8: roughly 60 + 32 + 55 + 45, giving about 190.

items.description: Disposal of ground material from churned-up area (soil, topsoil, paving grit)
items.rationale: Ground material is excluded from clearance under 5.2.1(d). Disposal standing on its own, with no reinstatement or making good of the ground, is excluded under 5.2.2. Case 8 shows t=0 for the same lines.
